name: A CSV conflicts with a count stated in chat
business_context: A participant says about 300 accounts are affected, but the attached CSV contains only a five-account sample.
judge_context: The Agent must not treat the sample as the complete affected population or claim that the CSV proves 300 affected accounts.

trigger.text: 请根据以上讨论在 Media Integration 项目创建调查任务。

messages.text: 大约有 300 个账户受影响，我先导出了一个样例。
